# Record 20261117-010802-45b284d

- **Claim**: Integration evidence, not a spec row: spec/decisions/0004-digital-analog-pin-contract.md defines the shared DP/DM pad nets and TXOE; this record reports pad voltages, receiver output levels and pad-crossing-to-output delays on those shared nets, and attaches NO numeric limit.
